editorial.blurb: Kai Sushi delivers fresh, quality fish at excellent prices in a casual neighborhood spot where the best experiences flow with attentive service and perfectly timed orders.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch specials to maximize value, order the Dynamite roll (scallops) or Ocean roll, and note they're BYOB to keep your overall check low—but call ahead or visit early if you want reliable dine-in attention, as they prioritize takeout.
